name: search-integrity
description: Search-history integrity contract (W051, the W035–W050 flat source-exported package pattern): the DECLARED record of everything tried during a search as typed DATA. history.ts is the SearchHistory — every trial (candidate descriptor as data + the sealed W050 PointInTimeView it consulted + the outcome citation CARRIED through W047's episode/batch provenance vocabulary, never re-scored), the selection decisions (which candidate chosen, citing WHICH sealed evidence, as of WHEN), the explicit scope, the immutable lineage, and the content-addressed search-<digest> id. integrity.ts is THE GATE (checkSearchIntegrity): a backtest claim must cite its COMPLETE search history — an undeclared trial is a loud typed violation naming §13; a selection consulting anything beyond its declared as-of point is refused naming R016 (the W050 firewall carried); claim evidence must trace to declared trials; verdicts are PASS/FAIL/PARTIAL findings in the W038 shape, feeding verification's own findings report. overfit.ts is the carried-statistics surface (trial counts, selection funnel shapes, redundancy measures — deterministic projections of the record, never invented, never re-scored). A9: pure, deterministic, no clocks, no randomness, no env reads. A14: composes typed records + verdicts — never executes backtests, never scores.
